paragraphs: R. Tuvi bar Kisna: “Shmuel said”—Bava Batra 19b; Yevamot 40b; Nedarim 12b; Ketubot 64a; Eruvin 104b; Menachot 41a. Menachot 70a has Rav Tavyomi bar Kisna saying in Shmuel's name, a scribal error.
